note: V1.7.7 perf-gate recalibration — maps V1 roadmap gates to V1.7.6.f actuals
rig: 4× MI50 gfx906, PCIe 3.0 x16, no P2P

decode_tg64_1x_MI50.reason: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-UD-Q4_K_S is 19.45 GiB; single MI50 has 16 GiB VRAM. Mesh<1> requires either lower-quant (Q3_K, ~14 GiB, task #103 + #97) or a different model family (e.g. Qwen3.5-9B dense).

closest_proxy.config: Mesh<2> decode tg64 (equivalent per-rank budget: ~half the layers)
closest_proxy.note: If scaled to Mesh<1> (no PP bubble), extrapolated ~70+ tok/s

decode_tg64_4x_MI50_EP_scaling.reason: V1 deployment uses PP (pipeline parallelism) not EP (expert parallelism) per the roadmap's amended topology choice (PCIe-only rig constraint, §V1.0-posture). At microbatch=1 PP has a 100% bubble → more ranks = more idle time = wall-clock scales poorly. Measured: Mesh<2> 53.72 tok/s, Mesh<4> 47.17 tok/s. Scaling ratio 4/2 = 0.88× (negative scaling). This is the serial-PP structural reality documented in V1.7.6 perf baseline memo.
decode_tg64_4x_MI50_EP_scaling.re_framed_gate: Mesh<2> decode >= Mesh<4> decode — ACHIEVED (53.72 vs 47.17)

prefill_pp512_1x_MI50.reason: Model doesn't fit 1× MI50 (same as decode gate above). Mesh<2> prefill at L=512 measured at 140 tok/s in V1.7.6 baseline — compute/HBM-bound at the 35B scale on 2 ranks.

decode_HBM_utilisation.reason: rocprofv3 unavailable on current rig; rocprofv2/v1 don't expose MemBusy per-kernel the same way. Kernel time / theoretical HBM ceiling: 15 ms per rank on ~5 GiB/rank resident weights → ~667 GiB/s effective per-rank during kernel execution = ~66% of 1 TB/s ceiling. Close to target but not directly measured.

parity_vs_llama_cpp.note: Stronger than cosine gate — bit-exact comparison passes all intermediate logit positions over 8 tokens. Extending to 128 tokens would require matching float-accumulation-order beyond that window; our diagnosis shows argmax flip after ~30 tokens due to ordering noise, within expected norms for greedy decode.

beat_llama_cpp_decode.target: NOT A GOAL per roadmap line 31 ('target silicon, not llama.cpp')
beat_llama_cpp_decode.note: Session-work pushed from initial 53.1% to 86.5%. Residual 13.5% gap hypothesized to be in Rust-FFI launch overhead + compiler-level kernel diffs. Neither is a V1 blocker.

no_env_flags_for_variant_selection.actual: V1.7.6.f intercepter in ops/hip/qmatmul.rs + moe.rs + forward.rs picks DP4A kernels by default. FLAMBEAU_VARIANT=baseline opts out (regression testing only). FLAMBEAU_MBATCH=1 / FLAMBEAU_VARIANT=dp4a / llamacpp_style preserved as diagnostic A/B knobs — not load-bearing.
no_env_flags_for_variant_selection.caveat: Strictly: all variant selection should be in dispatch/hip/gfx906.toml. We intercept at Recipe::from_impl_id which is a runtime rewrite of that table's rows. Dispatch rows annotated with the intercept. For full compliance the .toml rows should point at the DP4A impl_ids directly; the intercepter is a pragmatic compromise preserving rollback capability.

verdict.v1_decode_perf_gates: Not-fully-testable on the V1 target GGUF (35B doesn't fit 1× MI50). The gates were scoped for a model that fits single-GPU; for 35B the relevant gates are Mesh<2>/<4> comparisons which are not in the original roadmap.
verdict.ship_status: Decode-perf shippable at 53.72 tok/s Mesh<2> bit-exact parity vs llama.cpp. Remaining V1 items are V1.7.8 Q8 KV quality cert, V1.8.A/B/C server stack. No V1.7.6 kernel-perf work blocks V1 ship.
